description: The wire payload arrives with a Content-Digest header that does not match the SHA-256 of the body bytes. A conformant verifier MUST reject the request with HTTP 401 / JSON-RPC -32001 before any signature verification is attempted (per §5.3). This vector starts from Vector 2 and tampers only the body bytes; the signature itself is valid for the body the sender originally signed.

inputs.tampering: The Content-Digest and Signature were originally computed over Vector 2's body {"task":"summarize","url":"https://example.com/doc"}. Body has been replaced in transit; headers were not re-signed.

expected.verifier_behavior: Recompute SHA-256 of body_received_bytes_utf8 → does not equal the digest in the Content-Digest header → reject with -32001. Do not proceed to signature reconstruction or Ed25519 verification.
